name: cryptosweep
description: Post-quantum cryptography scanner: inventory cryptography, flag quantum-vulnerable primitives, and compute harvest-now-decrypt-later (Mosca-clock) risk.
author: Grandillionaire

tools.name: scan

tools.description: List the confidentiality data classes and their secrecy horizons available for the risk model.
